findings.location: src/http/inbox.ts findInboxItems (listDeferredInboxTasks limit 100 DESC / listInstanceInboxTasks limit 200 ASC)
findings.issue: Fix 3 reorders only WITHIN the DB-limit window that findInboxItems fetches. A tenant with >200 waiting instance tasks has its NEWEST instance rows fall outside the ORDER BY occurred_at ASC LIMIT 200 window entirely, so they appear on NO page of the unscoped list regardless of the escalated-last partition. Pre-existing truncation, orthogonal to T-0710; mitigated for the scoped case by fix 2.
findings.suggestion: Follow-up: raise/paginate the source LIMIT or order instance reads DESC for the inbox; not required for this task.

findings.issue: A malformed non-UUID ?instance= value is passed straight into the parameterized WHERE (no assertUuid on instanceId, only on tenantId) and yields a silent empty 200 rather than a 400. Injection is excluded (proven: parameterized $3/$4). Acceptable filter semantics but not validated.
findings.suggestion: Optional: soft-validate instance= and 400 on obviously malformed input, or leave as honest empty result.

findings.issue: Corner: base superseded (instancesWithAnyNextTask) but ALL next_task rows already approved and instance NOT yet ended -> concurrentNextSteps empty, base excluded, defensive push re-adds the STALE base `step`. concurrentSteps=[stale base]. Honest-degrade (no crash, no null), a rare transient before the next reconcile surfaces the real next task.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable. If desired, prefer showing the last approved next-step label over the base label in that window.
